articles.title: BS27-1: Feeding the fight, sustaining readiness
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 718th Force Support Squadron demonstrated their ability to establish an alternate dining facility using Jack's Place to prepare and serve meals during Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 29, 2026.

articles.title: 44th Fighter Squadron welcomes new commander
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Lt. Col. Matthew Zipper assumed command of the 44th Fighter Squadron during an assumption of command ceremony at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 19, 2026.

articles.title: Mustangs of the Week: 1st Lt. Alfonso Morales & TSgt. Taylor Anderson
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force 1st Lt. Alfonso Morales, 51st Security Forces Squadron flight commander, and Tech. Sgt. Taylor Anderson, 51st SFS flight chief, were recognized as Mustangs of the Week at Osan Air Base, Republic of Korea, Oct. 26, 2026.

articles.title: Ironclad runways: U.S. and Japan reinforce ExR-ADR capabilities during KS27
articles.summary: IRUMA AIR BASE, Japan - U.S., Japan, and Canadian Armed Forces collaborated in expeditionary rapid airfield damage repair (ExR-ADR) training during Exercise Keen Sword 27 at a Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) installation at Iruma Air Base, Japan, Oct. 22-26.

articles.title: U.S. Naval Hospital Okinawa strengthens bilateral medical readiness during Keen Sword 27
articles.summary: CAMP FOSTER, Okinawa, Japan — U.S. Naval Hospital Okinawa personnel trained alongside Japan Self-Defense Forces and joint medical partners during Keen Sword 27, a bilateral exercise that tested the hospital’s ability to receive, triage and treat large numbers of simulated casualties Oct. 26-27.

articles.title: NORAD fighter aircraft execute homeland defense mission from austere Eareckson Air Station
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force F-16 Fighting Falcons maintained air defense alert at Eareckson Air Station, Alaska, during an Oct. 18–26 deployment before launching a homeland defense mission on Oct. 25, integrating aircraft from two other Alaskan bases and one Canadian base.

articles.title: CSAF, CMSAF observe Team Osan mission readiness in action
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Chief of Staff Gen. Ken Wilsbach and Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force David Wolfe visited Osan Air Base, Republic of Korea, Oct. 22, 2026, gaining firsthand insight into how Team Osan integrates operations, maintenance and support capabilities to sustain readiness on the Korean Peninsula.

articles.title: Army HF Gateway teams demonstrate communications readiness during Noble Skywave
articles.summary: U.S. Army Network Enterprise Technology Command (NETCOM), the 78th Signal Battalion and the 30th Signal Battalion participated in Noble Skywave, a Canadian-hosted high-frequency (HF) communications exercise, last week, testing the skills and adaptability of Army signal professionals operating across a range of communications conditions.

articles.title: Guardsman scores 498 on AFT, outscores team of college athletes
articles.summary: Idaho Army National Guard Chief Warrant Officer 3 Emily Wood faced off against five Boise State University student-athletes in a friendly competition earlier this month, scoring 498 points on the Army Fitness Test to edge the Broncos’ combined score of 496.

articles.title: Hasty US exit from Europe could drive allies away from American arms, RAND says
articles.summary: A rapid, uncoordinated U.S. military drawdown from Europe could push key NATO allies further away from American weapons, a RAND study found.
